items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: He sort of sounded like Duncan and Palmisano, you know, those guys.

ctx.x: Old style clarinet, yeah. Old style piano. We had a fellow sat in with us just this past Sunday. I don't know his name. I don't know where he came from, but he was a pretty good pianist. And we did a version on Millenberg. And, I mean, this guy could really pawn a piano.
He sort of sounded like Duncan and Palmisano, you know, those guys.

I'm sorry I didn't catch his name. He'd probably come back up again. Well, just that type of music attracts them, they will be back, see, and they're going to want to play again. We're always glad to have them play.
